task: Sweep stale branches only when current tip exactly matches a merged same-repository PR head

events.summary: Exclude default, protected, release, open-PR, reused, and unpublished branches
Historical merged branches remain after normal PR completion
Require current branch SHA to equal a merged same-repository PR head SHA before exact-ref deletion
Open PRs and branches without exact merged-head proof remain retained
Deletion remains exact-ref only and release/protected/default branches are explicitly excluded
The sweep can remove only branches with explicit merged-PR tip identity evidence
Stale merged branches can be cleaned without treating age or ancestry as deletion authority
